To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the impact of globalization on the banking industry is perceived by managers as being both positive and negative.

(a) managers and professionals perceive globalization as unfair, (b) they view it as endangering the Nigerian economy and cultural values, (c) they believe that it is open enough to incorporate other systems of economy and politics, (d) they believe that globalization has the potential of transferring good management practices and foreign direct investment, and (e) they believe that nation states cannot formulate polices favourable for their economies.

(1) The majority of the respondents (70%) view the outcome of globalisation as unfair, (2) The majority (60%) of the respondents view globalisation as endangering the Nigerian economy, and (3) The majority (65%) of the respondents see globalisation as a hindrance to the formulation of policies that will favour the economy.
